searchText: The Goerli announcement for their merge is slated for the 6th-12th, but when exactly are the devs aiming for it ideally? As of now, https://bordel.wtf/ estimates it will hit on the 12th. Are we expecting to ramp up the hash power to have it happen earlier? Goerli testnet pre-merge is Proof of Authority and not Proof of Work so can't ramp up the hash power. From the announcement: https://blog.ethereum.org/2022/07/27/goerli-prater-merge-announcement/ > The volatility in incremental difficulty per block makes estimating a window for the TTD harder than with a block or epoch height, hence the wider expected range. Users should note that this will also be the case for mainnet’s transition due to changes in proof-of-work hash rate. In true merge style, it'll happen when it happens. After my ski trip, hopefully 🤞⛷️ 🤞 so is the bordel link I have above just not a good estimator of this? murphys law may dictate that it'll be in the middle of the best day of your trip <@361447803194441738> 🙂 No idea if it's right or wrong, I don't think we've ever tried to estimate Görli TD progress before really. We'll see I guess. If it winds up being out by too much we can adjust the target TTD but we'll try to avoid that as it requires everyone to reconfigure their nodes and is likely to cause more problems. This is the same on MainNet really - we won't be able to predict perfectly (though it is easier than with Görli in many ways) and will just have to watch and wait. right, but on mainnet, it is PoW, and we can see progress on the TTD and the hashrate is a bit more predictable (short of some miner shenanigans) Görli has well defined rules for how the TD will increase - 1 for every block produced by an out of turn validator, 2 for those produced by an in-turn validator. But Mainnet hashrate can vary quite a bit too depending on whether miners start dropping off early or not, the DAG increase potentially bricking a bunch of lower memory cards etc. So in both cases, we can compute a likely range and then watch and see what happens. is there a place where I can see the current TTD Goerli has reached so far? TTD = terminal total difficulty, that's the config option specified in clients for when to switch to PoS. You want to track the TD (total difficulty) which is shown for every block in etherscan just like for MainNet And is also tracked on bordel.wtf https://bordel.wtf/ > Görli has well defined rules for how the TD will increase - 1 for every block produced by an out of turn validator, 2 for those produced by an in-turn validator If anyone has contact w/ the other goerli validators these days and can nudge them into being healthy we should see a lot less blocks w/ difficulty `1` right? The hard part is knowing which validators are acting up since I'm not sure if the full list is published anywhere? (the validators _producing_ blocks w/ difficulty `1` aren't the problem, they are just making up for the in-turn validators not producing in time).

excerpts.author: abcoathup
excerpts.content:
Goerli testnet pre-merge is Proof of Authority and not Proof of Work so can't ramp up the hash power.

From the announcement: https://blog.ethereum.org/2022/07/27/goerli-prater-merge-announcement/
> The volatility in incremental difficulty per block makes estimating a window for the TTD harder than with a block or epoch height, hence the wider expected range. Users should note that this will also be the case for mainnet’s transition due to changes in proof-of-work hash rate.
